💧 A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "We've made it this far. That's not luck, that's us."
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
You give A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 76/100)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s telling A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek about you. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "Yeah. Yeah, okay. That's solid."
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek telling A person, maybe 50s about A woman, maybe 20s. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — Greta telling A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek about A woman, maybe 20s. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek telling Kyle about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
🌿 A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns from foraging the wilds: +222 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 222 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek telling Pengfei about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 60s, with a scarred cheek has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the man in his 60s, with tattooed arms mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Marvin asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it

A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log. Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap."
You catch fragments by the fire — Jovan telling A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek drew a medium tree with glossy oval leaves and round orange fruit like small apples in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek sets out for the absence of sound, shaped like wings. "Meat's meat. Back with it or not at all."
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek telling Greta about Jovan. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s telling A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s telling A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek about A person, maybe 20s. The retelling is already better than the event.
🥩 A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek is back empty-handed. "Nothing worth hauling out there."
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably." The pantry won't fill itself.
